name: The Mortal
pitch: You woke sixteen because someone who loved you gave up their life, then a hunter came for you because of it, and every blow takes back a year of what they gave.
channel: none: the first firing of each enemy art turns on its owner

new.name: The Received Years
new.effect: The person named on a Set Day, while the giver lives: the years received become a wick that blows and terror burn, and an art's first firing at them turns. Closes any cultivation.
new.second_home: any build's bonded person, any hostage event

new.name: Plain Blow
new.effect: A single hit on a side with no linh lực at all removes at most 8 health before body guard. Ticks and soul are not limited.
new.second_home: any levy row, The Ant General's ranks, a mortal-bodied puppet

new.name: Callus Returns
new.effect: After 80 seasons have gone from a wick, +1 body guard base for the fight.
new.second_home: any build whose age is moved back

new.name: Measure Taken
new.effect: An art that has turned never turns twice in that fight. Its owner has corrected their aim.

new.name: Mortal Body
new.effect: A side the caller creates for one fight: no linh lực, no ward, no arts, a power term below Qi Refining (power 10 as a first guess). Carries Plain Blow. Combat rule 23, Realms.
new.second_home: mortal-bodied puppets, a hostage event, Levy rows

new.name: Merged self-hit rule
new.effect: One rule replaces Slip of the Hand's and Turned Hand's copies: a turned art pays, and its hit resolves on its owner at the same size and M, through their own ward and guard, with no suppression, at most 25 % of their maximum health. Basic attacks, companions, ticks and arts with no hit never turn. Three doors decide when: the fortune roll, the curse, The Received Years.
new.second_home: The Lucky Fool, The Stand-In, Way of Chance

new.name: Stamped Jack
new.effect: A mass-made coat that costs no thần thức, by Stamped Iron's rule. Carries the Maximum health and Body guard notables.

questions: Is 25 % the right clip for the merged self-hit? Slip's 30 % falls to it.
Should a mortal be a side at all? Realms says mortals are not simulated. This asks only for one the caller creates.
A stalemate here ends a beating by the clock. Why the hunter leaves is left to the caller. Is that acceptable?
